experiment.topic: Gap-down quality in BTC-USD: 30-hour mean reversion probability after 2% gap-down events
experiment.hypothesis: After a 2% gap-down event in BTC-USD, price exhibits a 30-hour mean reversion with a 90% probability of returning to within 5% of the pre-gap level, indicating liquidity-driven reversion rather than structural breakdown.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If, across at least 50 BTC-USD gap-down events (>2% drop) followed by a 30-hour period, the average return is greater than 5% (i.e., positive reversion), then the hypothesis is falsified.
